name: Oauth2Authorize
summary: OAuth2.0 Pushed Authorization Request (PAR) standard authorize API

get.summary: OAuth2.0 Pushed Authorization Request (PAR) standard authorize API
get.description: Core OAuth2 authorization endpoint following RFC 9126 PAR spec, only accepts authorization request via request_uri parameter to trigger user authorization flow

parameters.name: request_uri
parameters.description: OAuth 2.0 PAR standard request URI, references authorization parameters for the OAuth2 flow

302.description: Authorization flow initiated successfully - redirect to user consent page via Location header

400.description: OAuth2 Invalid Request - invalid request_uri format, expired authorization request or malformed parameters

404.description: OAuth2 Invalid Request - authorization request not found for the provided request_uri (no matching PAR registration)

500.description: OAuth2 Server Error - temporary OAuth2 flow service issue, unable to process authorization request
